title: The chapel's recovered bell (pried from a fused frame in Emberfall's vestry) and the warped bronze bell-clapper (found atop the Cinder Watch tower) are clearly meant to be a matched pair — both unique items, both about the same broken bell — but no location or dialogue ever offered a way to actually reunite them.
